env.description:
Env maps variable names (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,255}$) to values. Values
must not contain NUL bytes. An empty environment is {}.

title: WorkloadEnv: plaintext sealed into NodeState workloads[].env.sealed (crypto_box_seal)
description: WorkloadEnv is the plaintext inside WorkloadSpec.env.sealed (docs/03 §6): libsodium crypto_box_seal of the UTF-8 JSON encoding of this object, addressed to the daemon's X25519 key.
